# voipms_recordings (Data Source)

Lists audio recordings (`getRecordings`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_recordings" "all" {}

output "recordings_by_description" {
  value = { for r in data.voipms_recordings.all.recordings : r.description => r.id }
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier (`recordings`).
- `recordings` (Attributes List) Recordings on this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recordings))

<a id="nestedatt--recordings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recordings`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Recording description, as typed in the portal (e.g. `Main Greeting`).
- `id` (String) Recording id. This is the value other resources want: `voipms_voicemail` `unavailable_message_recording`, `voipms_ring_group` `caller_announcement`.
